name: x
description: A centered close mark with two balanced diagonal strokes.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Two straight 45-degree strokes cross at 12,12 with endpoint coordinates 5.5 and 18.5. The line-symbol silhouette intentionally uses no outer frame or enclosed counter. Equal Regular 1.70 visible margins are 4.65 units. Rounded free ends and the shared center retain the established family weight. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70 are the reference. Round 3 draft awaiting owner review.
